demoValues.eventDescription: An event created automatically through the UI for the presentation walkthrough.

segments.title: Organizer Event Management
actions: Show the organizer event list and navigation.
Point out that organizer-only options are available.
say: We start on the organizer side, already authenticated as an organizer.
From here, the organizer can manage events and move into the event creation flow.

segments.title: Create Event
actions: Auto-fill the form and submit it through the real UI.
say: Now the organizer creates a new event through the UI.
The form submission creates a real event record in the backend database.

segments.title: Add Ticket Type
actions: Open the ticket type form for the newly created event.
Auto-fill the ticket type and submit it.
say: Next, the organizer creates a ticket type for this event.
That makes the event claimable for attendees.

segments.title: Assign Staff
actions: Auto-add the demo staff account to the event by email.
say: Now the organizer assigns a staff member to the event.
In the current version, staff assignment uses the staff account email instead of the user ID.
Only assigned staff should be able to validate tickets for that event.

segments.title: Attendee Claim Ticket
actions: Open the event detail page as an attendee.
Use the real Claim Ticket button and navigate to the ticket detail page.
say: On the attendee side, the ticket is claimed through the event page.
The attendee receives a unique QR token for check-in.

segments.title: Staff Scan Success
actions: Open the scanner as the assigned staff user.
Auto-submit the claimed QR token and show the VALID result.
say: The backend checks that the ticket belongs to the event and has not already been used, then it records the check-in.

segments.title: Duplicate Scan Prevention
actions: Scan the same QR token again.
say: If the same ticket is scanned again, duplicate prevention is triggered immediately.

segments.title: Organizer Dashboard Live Update
actions: Return to the organizer dashboard that has been open in the background.
Point out the updated checked-in count and recent activity feed.
say: Back on the organizer dashboard, the checked-in count and recent activity update without refreshing.
This demonstrates our real-time functionality using Socket.IO.
In one workflow, we demonstrated organizer management, attendee ticketing, staff validation, database persistence, and live dashboard updates.
